comments.author: frostybito
comments.body:
Ram is only useful for local models when it's unified ram, otherwise you need vram. You're only pointing to regular ddr5 ram and cpu (doesn't rlly matter if you have 32gb or 128gb it will be slow as shit brother). A gpu with 16gb vram will mog the fuq out of 128gb ddr5 (and cpu) for local inference.

For other workstation related stuff, your hardware is rock solid just as I am writing this :)
